key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch to enable or disable automatic PWA icon matching.

key.name: auto-match-new
key.description: Monitor applications directory and match icons when new PWAs are installed.

key.name: startup-scan
key.summary: Scan existing PWA launchers at startup
key.description: Perform a single asynchronous pass over existing launchers on startup.

key.name: browser-independent
key.description: Use modular adapters to detect PWAs across all supported browsers.

key.name: exact-matching
key.description: Require exact normalized match with the active theme to avoid unsafe fuzzy guesses.

key.name: browser-brave
key.description: Detect PWAs installed using Brave Browser.

key.name: browser-chrome
key.description: Detect PWAs installed using Google Chrome.

key.name: browser-chromium
key.description: Detect PWAs installed using Chromium or Ungoogled Chromium.

key.name: browser-edge
key.description: Detect PWAs installed using Microsoft Edge.

key.name: browser-epiphany
key.description: Detect Web Apps installed using GNOME Web / Epiphany.

key.name: browser-generic
key.description: Detect PWAs with unambiguous PWA argument markers from other browsers.

key.name: custom-aliases
key.description: Dictionary mapping application names to specific icon theme names.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: List of application names or desktop filenames to exclude from automatic modification.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Enable lightweight diagnostic log messages in system journal and preferences.
